title: orobanche alba f. major
intro: Orobanche alba f. major, commonly known as the parasitic white broomrape, is a plant species that belongs to the broomrape family (Orobanchaceae). This plant is known for its parasitic nature, where it derives its nutrients by attaching to the roots of other plants, specifically those in the genus Thymus. The health benefits of Orobanche alba f. major include its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can be used to treat various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, which have been reported to possess antioxidant, cytotoxic, and immunomodulatory activities.
